beats.text: It is an assembly line nightmare: every branch re-computes the entire state, ignoring that most tokens never change.

beats.text: SpecFold pivots the architecture by using token-level residual gating to identify exactly which tokens actually changed.

I understood exactly why it's faster without feeling like I was being talked down to.
